trim_video_absolute_times: create a VideoAugmenterByTrim with start and end seconds to trim a video to an exact time range
trim_video_offset_duration_factors: create a VideoAugmenterByTrim with offset_factor and duration_factor to trim a video using proportional time ranges
trim_video_from_start: create a VideoAugmenterByTrim with only an end time to trim a video from the beginning to a specific point
trim_video_to_end: create a VideoAugmenterByTrim with only a start time to trim a video from a specific point to the end
get_ffmpeg_trim_command: call get_command on VideoAugmenterByTrim to generate the FFMPEG CLI command list for trimming a video
